items.label: Config
items.content:
# AI Instance - Configuration

```javascript
const client = new AIClient({
  apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY',
  model: 'openai',
  stream: true,
  isImage: false,
  seed: 12345,
  chatId: 't1',
  systemPrompt('You are...')
});
```
- Creates a new text AI client instance.
- `apiKey` – your API key.
- `model` – AI model to use.
- `stream` – enable streaming responses.
- `isImage` – false, text only.
- `seed` – reproducible outputs.
- `chatId` – unique session ID.
- `systemPrompt()` – instructions for the AI.
- History can be set manually via `client.setHistory([...])` or cleared with `client.clearHistory()`.

items.label: Stream
.generate()
items.content:
# Generate Text

```javascript
await client.generate('Write a short motivational quote about AI.');
```
- Generates text using the client.
- Uses streaming if enabled.
- Seed ensures repeatable output.
- History must be manually managed outside if you want context preservation.

items.label: .destroy()
items.content:
# Cleanup Text Client

```javascript
client.destroy();
```
- Frees resources.
- Removes chat session.
- Use for fresh session or app shutdown.

items.label: Init
items.content:
# Init Image Client

```javascript
const client = new AIClient({
  apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY',
  model: 'flux',
  isImage: true,
  width: 1024,
  height: 1024,
  seed: 12345,
  chatId: 'i1'
});
```
- Creates a new image AI client.
- `apiKey` – your API key.
- `model` – image model alias.
- `isImage` – true.
- `width` & `height` – output size.
- `seed` – reproducible images.
- `chatId` – unique session ID.
- History can be set manually via `client.setHistory([...])` for text contexts.

items.label: Config
Generate
items.content:
# Generate Image

```javascript
const blob = await client.generate('Futuristic city at sunset');
document.querySelector('#output-image').src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
```
- Generates an image.
- Auto cleanup removes `chatId`.
- Seed ensures reproducible results.
- Image history is not tracked; only relevant for text messages.

items.label: Cleanup
items.content:
# Cleanup Image Client

```javascript
client.destroy();
```
- Frees resources.
- Removes chat session.
- Use before app shutdown or fresh session.
